<style>
    :root {
        --cyber-blue: #00f2ff;
        --cyber-purple: #7000ff;
        --cyber-cyan: #0ff;
        --cyber-dark: #050505;
        --cyber-border: rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.3);
    }

    /* ===== CYBER TABLE CARD ===== */
    .cyber-table-card {
        background: #000000;
        backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.2);
        border-radius: 15px;
        padding: 1.5rem;
        box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.05);
        position: relative;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }

    .cyber-table-card::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: -50%;
        right: -50%;
        width: 200%;
        height: 200%;
        background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 50%, rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1) 0%, transparent 50%);
        pointer-events: none;
    }

    @keyframes floatBg {
        0%, 100% { transform: translate(0, 0); }
        50% { transform: translate(20px, 20px); }
    }

    .cyber-table-card:hover {
        box-shadow:
                0 0 80px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.2),
                inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.08),
                0 12px 48px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
    }

    /* ===== TABLE STYLES ===== */
    .table {
        color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.85);
        border-color: rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1);
        margin-bottom: 0;
        background-color: transparent;
        position: relative;
        z-index: 2;
    }

    .table > :not(caption) > * > * {
        background-color: transparent;
    }

    .table thead th {
        color: var(--cyber-blue);
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        letter-spacing: 1px;
        border-bottom: 2px solid rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.3);
        padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.2);
    }

    .table tbody td {
        padding: 1rem 0.5rem;
        vertical-align: middle;
        border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .table tbody tr {
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
    }

    .table tbody tr:hover td {
        background: rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.12);
        box-shadow: inset 0 0 20px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.08);
    }

    .table tbody tr:last-child td {
        border-bottom: none;
    }

    /* ===== TEXT STYLES ===== */
    .price-tag {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 700;
        font-size: 1rem;
        text-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.4);
    }

    .contact-name,
    .user-name,
    .category-name {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.4);
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .user-greeting small {
        color: #ffffff !important;
    }
    .contact-info {
        color: #ffffff !important;
        font-weight: 500;
        text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.3);
    }

    /* ===== QTY TAG ===== */
    .qty-tag {
        color: #fff;
        background: rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.15);
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.3);
        padding: 6px 14px;
        border-radius: 20px;
        font-size: 0.9rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        display: inline-block;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        box-shadow: 0 0 10px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .qty-tag:hover {
        background: rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.25);
        box-shadow: 0 0 20px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.2);
    }

    /* ===== BADGE STYLES ===== */
    .badge {
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem;
        font-weight: 600;
        border-radius: 12px;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        transition: all 0.3s ease;
        box-shadow: 0 0 15px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.1);
    }

    .badge.bg-success {
        background: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.2) !important;
        color: #22c55e !important;
        border-color: rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.4) !important;
        text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(34, 197, 94, 0.3);
    }

    .badge.bg-danger {
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.2) !important;
        color: #ef4444 !important;
        border-color: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4) !important;
        text-shadow: 0 0 5px rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.3);
    }

    /* Role-specific badges */
    .role-admin {
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.15);
        color: #ef4444;
        border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
    }

    .role-user {
        background: rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.15);
        color: #00f2ff;
        border: 1px solid rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.4);
    }

    .badge:hover {
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 0 25px rgba(0, 242, 255, 0.2);
    }

    /* ===== ALERT STYLES ===== */
    .alert-danger-cyber {
        border: 1px solid rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.4);
        background: rgba(239, 68, 68, 0.1);
        border-radius: 16px;
        backdrop-filter: blur(20px);
        color: #ef4444;
    }

    /* ===== RESPONSIVE ===== */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
        .cyber-table-card {
            padding: 1.5rem;
        }

        .table thead th {
            font-size: 0.75rem;
            padding: 0.75rem 0.35rem;
        }

        .table tbody td {
            padding: 0.75rem 0.35rem;
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }

        .price-tag {
            font-size: 0.9rem;
        }
    }
</style>
